name: A merged PR warns but still permits a multi-agent review
description: Proves AC-35: on a MERGED PR the launch control warns yet still PERMITS a run. Uses the seeded merged demo PR #471 ('Cache session lookups in Redis', status merged), reached via the 'All' status filter — the list defaults to 'Needs review', which hides merged PRs. Both the 'All' filter chip and the AgentPicker trigger are React <button>s opened with a native HTMLElement.click() eval (e2e/INSIGHTS.md 2026-07-06). The header shows the merged banner ('…running a review is informational…'), and the opened picker shows 'Pick agents to run' WITH the 'Run multi-agent review (N)' action still present — the merged status does not block the launch (permits). LLM-free: the panel only opens; no run is launched. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB.

cmd: (()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='All');if(!b)throw new Error('All filter chip not found');b.click();})()
steps.label: switch the status filter to All (merged PRs are hidden under the default Needs review)
the seeded merged PR #471 row appears under All
navigate to the merged PR detail route
the header warns the PR is already merged (AC-35 — warns)

cmd: (()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.includes('Run Review'));if(!b)throw new Error('Run Review trigger not found');b.scrollIntoView();b.click();})()
steps.label: open the AgentPicker on the merged PR (native click)
the AgentPicker panel opened AND its run action is present on the merged PR — merged does not block the launch (AC-35 — permits)
the 'Configure agents…' footer confirms the opened picker
